name: Ralph Fricksel
source:
Affiliation: ICSEO - Fair Messenger
Post: SG Pilot
Birthplace: Milky Way Colony

His colony was saved by an ICSEO ace pilot so he aimed to also become a pilot in the future.
He is completely devoted to that man and would do anything for him.
